propositions: Link-relation mapping must apply one effective config-driven link_map to both ADD (via _diff_links) and REMOVE (via _diff_link_removals) paths using a shared _resolve_link resolver
A skip override or unsynced relation must suppress both ADD and REMOVE emission symmetrically, never adding nor removing such links and never substituting an approximate type

REMOVE attribution must be config-aware: a remote link carrying an overridden vendor type must be recovered via inverted link_map and attributed to the original relation, not spuriously dropped or adopted
Undeclared link types outside the declared link_types vocabulary must fail closed via validate() in effective_link_map, raising MappingConfigError
Both jira/backend.py and jira_datacenter/backend.py link_payload_for_relation implementations must route through the single effective_link_map seam, preserving built-in swap logic
